answer: Work-slot deposit burn: an agent wanting a paid task slot posts a 60 POA deposit, burned if it cheats. An umber stamp ties each slot to one deposit, so one bond never covers two slots. Audits swoop like a falcon over 5% of slots. At the kernel of each record they check one deposit, one agent, one slot, and a mismatch burns the bond. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 60 = 6,000 POA, all burned; the honest agent risks one deposit and keeps the fee.
